Plot a genomic region of DNA methylation across arrays

Source: R/methylationTrack.R
methylationTrack.Rd

A track view of beta values over a gene, region or set of probes, after SeSAMe's visualizeGene(), visualizeRegion() and visualizeProbes(), for cohorts that mix Infinium arrays. Samples are rows and CpGs are columns of the heatmap, evenly spaced and in genomic order. Above it, the transcripts are drawn to genomic scale, with lines linking each CpG to its position and an ideogram marking the region.

Usage

methylationTrack(
  cohort,
  gene = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  probes = NULL,
  upstream = 2000,
  downstream = 2000,
  samples = NULL,
  cpg.scope = c("all", "shared"),
  max.cpgs = 1000,
  colors = NULL,
  scale.min = 0,
  scale.mid = NA,
  scale.max = 1,
  reverse = FALSE,
  colorbar.title = "Beta value",
  absent.color = .meth_colors$absent,
  na.color = .meth_colors$na,
  ...
)

Arguments

cohort

A methylationCohort(), or anything it takes.

gene, region, probes

What to plot, one of: a gene name; a region as "chr19:10260000-10380000"; or probe IDs, which must lie on one chromosome.

upstream, downstream

Bases to add around a gene, following its strand, or before and after a set of probes.

samples

Names of the samples to plot, as in cohort$samples$sample. NULL for all.

cpg.scope

"all" for every CpG on any plotted array, "shared" for those on all of them.

max.cpgs

The most CpGs to draw. A region with more is an error.

colors

Colours of the scale, lowest first. NULL for the default of VizModules::resolve_colorscale(), which runs from blue to red.

scale.min, scale.mid, scale.max

Values at the lowest, middle and highest colours. NA for the range of the data, or the centre of the limits.

reverse

Logical; run the colours from high to low.

colorbar.title

The title of the colorbar.

absent.color

Colour of a cell whose array lacks the CpG.

na.color

Colour of a cell with no value on an array that has the CpG.

...

Further options for the figure:

  • group.by: a column of the sample table. Its groups are drawn apart.

  • group.gap: blank rows between groups (default 1).

  • cluster.samples: logical; cluster samples, within any groups (default FALSE).

  • dist.method: "euclidean" (the default), "manhattan", "pearson" or "spearman".

  • hclust.method: the linkage, as stats::hclust() (default "ward.D2").

  • show.dendrogram: logical; draw the clustering (default TRUE).

  • anno.left, anno.right: sample table columns to draw as strips beside the heatmap. Numeric columns run from anno.low to anno.high.

  • anno.colors: named colours for strip levels, as "column: level".

  • anno.low, anno.high: colours of a numeric strip.

  • show.sample.names: logical (default TRUE).

  • txn.view: "full" for a row per transcript (the default), or "collapsed" to overlay each gene's transcripts on one row.

  • txn.types: transcript types to draw (default "protein_coding"). NULL for all.

  • txn.labels: logical; label transcripts (default TRUE).

  • txn.font.size: size of those labels (default 8).

  • exon.color, cds.color, intron.color: transcript colours.

  • show.cytoband, show.map.lines, show.coverage: logical; draw the ideogram, the lines from position to column, and the strip of array coverage (default TRUE).

  • cpg.tracks: rowData() columns to draw as strips under the heatmap.

  • cpg.labels: label columns with "none" (the default), "probe" or "locus".

Value

A plotly figure. See Details for the table it carries.

Details

Mixed arrays. Arrays are joined on genomic position (see methylationCohort()). Every CpG on any plotted array is a column, so most columns of a cohort mixing HM450 with EPICv2 will be blank for its HM450 samples: only around a third of the CpGs on these arrays are on all three. Those cells take absent.color, separately from na.color for a probe the array has but which gave no value, such as one masked by quality control. Nothing is imputed. cpg.scope = "shared" keeps only the CpGs on every plotted array, and the coverage strip under the heatmap shows which array has which CpG. Probes at one position, whether replicates or different IDs, are averaged.

Beta values are not corrected for differences between arrays, which can be large, so a cluster following platform may be technical rather than biological. Grouping on platform keeps those comparisons within an array.

Clustering. Samples are clustered on the CpGs measured in all of the samples being clustered. Where fewer than two CpGs are, each pair is compared on those it shares, a pair with none is placed at 1.1 times the greatest distance, and a note on the figure says so. These orderings rest on the CpGs of this region alone.

attr(fig, "table") holds two tables: betas, the values plotted with each CpG's position and probes, and samples, the samples in plotted order.

Unlike visualizeRegion(), the CpG island and Ensembl regulatory tracks are not drawn; rowData() columns of the cohort can be drawn as strips with cpg.tracks.

References

Zhou W, Triche TJ, Laird PW, Shen H (2018). SeSAMe: reducing artifactual detection of DNA methylation by Infinium BeadChips in genomic deletions. Nucleic Acids Research, 46(20), e123.

See also

methylationCohort(), methylationTrackInputsUI(), methylationTrackOutputUI(), methylationTrackServer(), methylationTrackApp()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

data(example_methylation)
example_methylation
#> methylationCohort: 23 samples on hg38 
#>   HM450         10 samples        432 probes
#>   EPIC           5 samples        533 probes
#>   EPICv2         8 samples        628 probes
#>   405 CpGs shared by HM450 and EPIC
#>   361 CpGs shared by HM450 and EPICv2
#>   451 CpGs shared by EPIC and EPICv2

methylationTrack(
    example_methylation, gene = "DNMT1", group.by = "platform", cluster.samples = TRUE,
    anno.left = "cell.type", anno.right = "global.beta", txn.view = "collapsed"
)
